description: The file defines the interface CohortDAO, which specifies database operations related to Cohort and CohortMembership entities within the OpenMRS project.

classes.name: CohortDAO
classes.description: Interface for database operations related to Cohort and CohortMembership objects.

methods.name: getCohort
methods.description: Finds the Cohort with the specified primary key or name.

methods.name: getAllCohorts
methods.description: Retrieves all cohorts, with the option to include voided (deleted) ones.

methods.name: getCohortsContainingPatientId
methods.description: Finds all cohorts that contain a specific patient, optionally filtered by date and voided status.

methods.name: saveCohort
methods.description: Saves or updates a Cohort object in the database.

methods.name: getCohorts
methods.description: Finds cohorts matching a name fragment.

methods.name: deleteCohort
methods.description: Removes a cohort from the database.

methods.name: getCohortByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a cohort by its UUID.

methods.name: getCohortMembershipByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a CohortMembership by its UUID.

methods.name: getCohortMemberships
methods.description: Retrieves cohort memberships for a specific patient, optionally active on a certain date and including voided ones.

methods.name: saveCohortMembership
methods.description: Saves or updates a CohortMembership in the database.
